ministry: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Government of Punjab
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 transferred directly via DBT for the marriage of daughters belonging to SC, BC, and economically weaker families in Punjab.
exclusions: More than two daughters per family
documents_required: Age Proof of Bride (18 years or above)
Marriage Card and Bank Account Passbook
application_steps: Visit the nearest Sewa Kendra in Punjab or apply on the Dr. Ambedkar Portal (esz.punjab.gov.in).
Submit the application within 30 days before or after the marriage date along with income and domicile proofs.
Receive ₹51,000 directly into the beneficiary bank account via DBT after Tehsil Welfare Officer verification.
